"""
T5完整模型实现
包含编码器、解码器和主模型类

参考论文Section 2.1的模型架构
"""

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F
from typing import Optional, Tuple, Dict
import math
from loguru import logger


class T5LayerNorm(nn.Module):
    """
    T5的Layer Normalization
    
    论文Section 2.1提到：使用简化版本，只rescale不加bias
    """
    
    def __init__(self, hidden_size: int, eps: float = 1e-6):
        """
        Args:
            hidden_size: 隐藏层大小
            eps: 数值稳定性参数
        """
        super().__init__()
        self.weight = nn.Parameter(torch.ones(hidden_size))
        self.variance_epsilon = eps
    
    def forward(self, hidden_states: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
        """
        前向传播
        
        Args:
            hidden_states: [batch_size, seq_len, hidden_size]
            
        Returns:
            归一化后的hidden_states
        """
        # 计算方差（不减去均值，只rescale）
        variance = hidden_states.pow(2).mean(-1, keepdim=True)
        hidden_states = hidden_states * torch.rsqrt(variance + self.variance_epsilon)
        
        return self.weight * hidden_states


class T5DenseReluDense(nn.Module):
    """
    T5的前馈网络：Dense-ReLU-Dense
    
    论文Section 2.1
    """
    
    def __init__(self, d_model: int, d_ff: int, dropout: float = 0.1):
        """
        Args:
            d_model: 模型维度
            d_ff: 前馈网络隐藏层维度
            dropout: Dropout比率
        """
        super().__init__()
        self.wi = nn.Linear(d_model, d_ff, bias=False)  # 输入投影
        self.wo = nn.Linear(d_ff, d_model, bias=False)  # 输出投影
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(dropout)
    
    def forward(self, hidden_states: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
        """
        前向传播
        
        Args:
            hidden_states: [batch_size, seq_len, d_model]
            
        Returns:
            变换后的hidden_states [batch_size, seq_len, d_model]
        """
        hidden_states = self.wi(hidden_states)
        hidden_states = F.relu(hidden_states)
        hidden_states = self.dropout(hidden_states)
        hidden_states = self.wo(hidden_states)
        return hidden_states


class T5LayerFF(nn.Module):
    """
    T5的前馈层（包含Layer Norm和残差连接）
    """
    
    def __init__(self, d_model: int, d_ff: int, dropout: float = 0.1, layer_norm_eps: float = 1e-6):
        super().__init__()
        self.DenseReluDense = T5DenseReluDense(d_model, d_ff, dropout)
        self.layer_norm = T5LayerNorm(d_model, eps=layer_norm_eps)
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(dropout)
    
    def forward(self, hidden_states: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
        """前向传播（Pre-LN：先归一化再前馈，最后残差）"""
        forwarded_states = self.layer_norm(hidden_states)
        forwarded_states = self.DenseReluDense(forwarded_states)
        hidden_states = hidden_states + self.dropout(forwarded_states)
        return hidden_states


class T5Attention(nn.Module):
    """
    T5注意力层（包含Layer Norm和残差连接）
    
    集成了之前实现的MultiHeadAttention和RelativePositionBias
    """
    
    def __init__(
        self,
        d_model: int,
        num_heads: int,
        d_kv: int = 64,
        dropout: float = 0.1,
        has_relative_attention_bias: bool = False,
        relative_attention_num_buckets: int = 32,
        relative_attention_max_distance: int = 128,
        is_decoder: bool = False,
        layer_norm_eps: float = 1e-6
    ):
        super().__init__()
        
        self.is_decoder = is_decoder
        self.has_relative_attention_bias = has_relative_attention_bias
        
        # 注意力核心（这里简化实现，实际应使用之前的MultiHeadAttention）
        self.d_model = d_model
        self.num_heads = num_heads
        self.d_kv = d_kv
        self.inner_dim = num_heads * d_kv
        
        # Q, K, V投影
        self.q = nn.Linear(d_model, self.inner_dim, bias=False)
        self.k = nn.Linear(d_model, self.inner_dim, bias=False)
        self.v = nn.Linear(d_model, self.inner_dim, bias=False)
        self.o = nn.Linear(self.inner_dim, d_model, bias=False)
        
        # 相对位置偏置
        if has_relative_attention_bias:
            self.relative_attention_bias = nn.Embedding(relative_attention_num_buckets, num_heads)
        
        self.layer_norm = T5LayerNorm(d_model, eps=layer_norm_eps)
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(dropout)
    
    def forward(
        self,
        hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
        attention_mask: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
        key_value_states: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
        position_bias: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
        past_key_value: Optional[Tuple[torch.Tensor]] = None,
        use_cache: bool = False
    ) -> Tuple[torch.Tensor, ...]:
        """
        前向传播
        
        Args:
            hidden_states: 输入 [batch_size, seq_len, d_model]
            attention_mask: 注意力掩码
            key_value_states: 交叉注意力的K/V（解码器使用）
            position_bias: 位置偏置
            past_key_value: 缓存的K/V
            use_cache: 是否使用缓存
            
        Returns:
            (output, present_key_value, position_bias)
        """
        batch_size, seq_length = hidden_states.shape[:2]
        
        # Pre-LN
        normed_hidden_states = self.layer_norm(hidden_states)
        
        # 自注意力 vs 交叉注意力
        is_cross_attention = key_value_states is not None
        if is_cross_attention:
            query_states = self.q(normed_hidden_states)
            key_states = self.k(key_value_states)
            value_states = self.v(key_value_states)
        else:
            query_states = self.q(normed_hidden_states)
            key_states = self.k(normed_hidden_states)
            value_states = self.v(normed_hidden_states)
        
        # 分头
        query_states = self._split_heads(query_states)
        key_states = self._split_heads(key_states)
        value_states = self._split_heads(value_states)
        
        # 使用缓存
        if past_key_value is not None:
            key_states = torch.cat([past_key_value[0], key_states], dim=2)
            value_states = torch.cat([past_key_value[1], value_states], dim=2)
        
        present_key_value = (key_states, value_states) if use_cache else None
        
        # 计算注意力分数
        scores = torch.matmul(query_states, key_states.transpose(-2, -1))
        
        # 添加位置偏置
        if position_bias is None and self.has_relative_attention_bias:
            # 简化：使用零偏置（完整实现应使用RelativePositionBias）
            position_bias = torch.zeros(
                (1, self.num_heads, seq_length, key_states.shape[2]),
                device=scores.device,
                dtype=scores.dtype
            )
        
        if position_bias is not None:
            scores = scores + position_bias
        
        # 应用mask
        if attention_mask is not None:
            scores = scores + attention_mask
        
        # Softmax
        attn_weights = F.softmax(scores.float(), dim=-1).type_as(scores)
        attn_weights = self.dropout(attn_weights)
        
        # 加权求和
        attn_output = torch.matmul(attn_weights, value_states)
        attn_output = self._merge_heads(attn_output)
        
        # 输出投影
        attn_output = self.o(attn_output)
        
        # 残差连接
        hidden_states = hidden_states + self.dropout(attn_output)
        
        return hidden_states, present_key_value, position_bias
    
    def _split_heads(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
        """分割多头"""
        batch_size, seq_len = x.shape[:2]
        x = x.view(batch_size, seq_len, self.num_heads, self.d_kv)
        return x.permute(0, 2, 1, 3)  # [B, H, L, D]
    
    def _merge_heads(self, x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
        """合并多头"""
        batch_size = x.shape[0]
        x = x.permute(0, 2, 1, 3).contiguous()
        return x.view(batch_size, -1, self.inner_dim)


class T5Block(nn.Module):
    """
    T5的Transformer Block
    
    编码器block: 自注意力 + 前馈
    解码器block: 自注意力 + 交叉注意力 + 前馈
    """
    
    def __init__(
        self,
        d_model: int,
        d_ff: int,
        num_heads: int,
        d_kv: int = 64,
        dropout: float = 0.1,
        has_relative_attention_bias: bool = False,
        is_decoder: bool = False,
        layer_norm_eps: float = 1e-6
    ):
        super().__init__()
        self.is_decoder = is_decoder
        
        # 自注意力层
        self.layer = nn.ModuleList()
        self.layer.append(
            T5Attention(
                d_model=d_model,
                num_heads=num_heads,
                d_kv=d_kv,
                dropout=dropout,
                has_relative_attention_bias=has_relative_attention_bias,
                is_decoder=is_decoder,
                layer_norm_eps=layer_norm_eps
            )
        )
        
        # 解码器需要交叉注意力
        if is_decoder:
            self.layer.append(
                T5Attention(
                    d_model=d_model,
                    num_heads=num_heads,
                    d_kv=d_kv,
                    dropout=dropout,
                    has_relative_attention_bias=False,
                    is_decoder=False,  # 交叉注意力是全可见的
                    layer_norm_eps=layer_norm_eps
                )
            )
        
        # 前馈层
        self.layer.append(T5LayerFF(d_model, d_ff, dropout, layer_norm_eps))
    
    def forward(
        self,
        hidden_states: torch.Tensor,
        attention_mask: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
        position_bias: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
        encoder_hidden_states: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
        encoder_attention_mask: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
        past_key_value: Optional[Tuple[torch.Tensor]] = None,
        use_cache: bool = False
    ) -> Tuple:
        """
        前向传播
        
        Returns:
            (hidden_states, present_key_value, position_bias)
        """
        # 自注意力
        self_attn_past_key_value = past_key_value[:2] if past_key_value is not None else None
        hidden_states, self_attn_present, position_bias = self.layer[0](
            hidden_states,
            attention_mask=attention_mask,
            position_bias=position_bias,
            past_key_value=self_attn_past_key_value,
            use_cache=use_cache
        )
        
        present_key_value = self_attn_present
        
        # 交叉注意力（仅解码器）
        if self.is_decoder and encoder_hidden_states is not None:
            cross_attn_past_key_value = past_key_value[2:] if past_key_value is not None else None
            hidden_states, cross_attn_present, _ = self.layer[1](
                hidden_states,
                attention_mask=encoder_attention_mask,
                key_value_states=encoder_hidden_states,
                past_key_value=cross_attn_past_key_value,
                use_cache=use_cache
            )
            present_key_value = present_key_value + cross_attn_present
        
        # 前馈层
        ff_layer_idx = 2 if self.is_decoder else 1
        hidden_states = self.layer[ff_layer_idx](hidden_states)
        
        return hidden_states, present_key_value, position_bias


class T5Stack(nn.Module):
    """
    T5的编码器或解码器Stack
    """
    
    def __init__(
        self,
        config,
        embed_tokens: nn.Embedding,
        is_decoder: bool = False
    ):
        super().__init__()
        self.is_decoder = is_decoder
        self.embed_tokens = embed_tokens
        
        # 构建Transformer blocks
        self.block = nn.ModuleList([
            T5Block(
                d_model=config.d_model,
                d_ff=config.d_ff,
                num_heads=config.num_heads,
                d_kv=config.d_kv,
                dropout=config.dropout_rate,
                has_relative_attention_bias=(i == 0),  # 只有第一层有位置偏置
                is_decoder=is_decoder,
                layer_norm_eps=config.layer_norm_epsilon
            )
            for i in range(
                config.num_decoder_layers if is_decoder else config.num_encoder_layers
            )
        ])
        
        # 最终Layer Norm
        self.final_layer_norm = T5LayerNorm(config.d_model, eps=config.layer_norm_epsilon)
        self.dropout = nn.Dropout(config.dropout_rate)
    
    def forward(
        self,
        input_ids: torch.Tensor,
        attention_mask: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
        encoder_hidden_states: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
        encoder_attention_mask: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
        past_key_values: Optional[Tuple[Tuple[torch.Tensor]]] = None,
        use_cache: bool = False
    ) -> Tuple:
        """
        前向传播
        
        Args:
            input_ids: 输入token IDs [batch_size, seq_len]
            attention_mask: 注意力掩码
            encoder_hidden_states: 编码器输出（解码器使用）
            encoder_attention_mask: 编码器注意力掩码
            past_key_values: 缓存的K/V
            use_cache: 是否使用缓存
            
        Returns:
            (hidden_states, present_key_values)
        """
        # 嵌入
        hidden_states = self.embed_tokens(input_ids)
        hidden_states = self.dropout(hidden_states)
        
        # 通过所有blocks
        present_key_values = () if use_cache else None
        position_bias = None
        
        for i, block in enumerate(self.block):
            past_key_value = past_key_values[i] if past_key_values is not None else None
            
            hidden_states, present_kv, position_bias = block(
                hidden_states,
                attention_mask=attention_mask,
                position_bias=position_bias,
                encoder_hidden_states=encoder_hidden_states,
                encoder_attention_mask=encoder_attention_mask,
                past_key_value=past_key_value,
                use_cache=use_cache
            )
            
            if use_cache:
                present_key_values = present_key_values + (present_kv,)
        
        # 最终归一化
        hidden_states = self.final_layer_norm(hidden_states)
        hidden_states = self.dropout(hidden_states)
        
        return hidden_states, present_key_values


class T5Model(nn.Module):
    """
    T5主模型（编码器-解码器）
    
    论文Section 2.1的完整架构
    """
    
    def __init__(self, config):
        super().__init__()
        self.config = config
        
        # 共享词嵌入
        self.shared = nn.Embedding(config.vocab_size, config.d_model)
        
        # 编码器
        self.encoder = T5Stack(config, self.shared, is_decoder=False)
        
        # 解码器
        self.decoder = T5Stack(config, self.shared, is_decoder=True)
        
        # LM head（共享词嵌入权重）
        self.lm_head = nn.Linear(config.d_model, config.vocab_size, bias=False)
        if config.share_encoder_decoder_embeddings:
            self.lm_head.weight = self.shared.weight
        
        # 初始化
        self.apply(self._init_weights)
        
        logger.info(f"T5模型初始化完成")
        logger.info(f"  编码器层数: {config.num_encoder_layers}")
        logger.info(f"  解码器层数: {config.num_decoder_layers}")
        logger.info(f"  模型维度: {config.d_model}")
        logger.info(f"  参数量: {self.num_parameters() / 1e6:.1f}M")
    
    def _init_weights(self, module):
        """初始化权重"""
        factor = self.config.initializer_factor
        
        if isinstance(module, T5LayerNorm):
            module.weight.data.fill_(factor * 1.0)
        elif isinstance(module, nn.Embedding):
            module.weight.data.normal_(mean=0.0, std=factor * 1.0)
        elif isinstance(module, nn.Linear):
            module.weight.data.normal_(mean=0.0, std=factor * ((self.config.d_model) ** -0.5))
            if module.bias is not None:
                module.bias.data.zero_()
    
    def forward(
        self,
        input_ids: torch.Tensor,
        attention_mask: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
        decoder_input_ids: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
        decoder_attention_mask: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
        labels: Optional[torch.Tensor] = None,
        use_cache: bool = False,
        return_dict: bool = True
    ) -> Dict[str, torch.Tensor]:
        """
        前向传播
        
        Args:
            input_ids: 编码器输入 [batch_size, src_len]
            attention_mask: 编码器attention mask
            decoder_input_ids: 解码器输入 [batch_size, tgt_len]
            decoder_attention_mask: 解码器attention mask
            labels: 标签（用于计算loss）
            use_cache: 是否使用KV缓存
            return_dict: 是否返回字典
            
        Returns:
            包含loss, logits等的字典
        """
        # 编码
        encoder_outputs = self.encoder(
            input_ids=input_ids,
            attention_mask=attention_mask
        )
        encoder_hidden_states = encoder_outputs[0]
        
        # 解码
        if decoder_input_ids is None and labels is not None:
            # Teacher forcing: 使用labels作为decoder输入（右移一位）
            decoder_input_ids = self._shift_right(labels)
        
        decoder_outputs = self.decoder(
            input_ids=decoder_input_ids,
            attention_mask=decoder_attention_mask,
            encoder_hidden_states=encoder_hidden_states,
            encoder_attention_mask=attention_mask,
            use_cache=use_cache
        )
        
        sequence_output = decoder_outputs[0]
        
        # LM head
        logits = self.lm_head(sequence_output)
        
        # 计算loss
        loss = None
        if labels is not None:
            loss_fct = nn.CrossEntropyLoss(ignore_index=-100)
            loss = loss_fct(logits.view(-1, logits.size(-1)), labels.view(-1))
        
        if not return_dict:
            return (loss, logits, encoder_hidden_states)
        
        return {
            "loss": loss,
            "logits": logits,
            "encoder_last_hidden_state": encoder_hidden_states,
            "decoder_hidden_states": sequence_output,
        }
    
    def _shift_right(self, input_ids: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
        """
        将标签右移一位作为解码器输入
        
        [BOS, token1, token2, EOS] -> [BOS, token1, token2]
        """
        shifted_input_ids = input_ids.new_zeros(input_ids.shape)
        shifted_input_ids[:, 1:] = input_ids[:, :-1].clone()
        shifted_input_ids[:, 0] = self.config.decoder_start_token_id if hasattr(self.config, 'decoder_start_token_id') else 0
        return shifted_input_ids
    
    def num_parameters(self) -> int:
        """计算参数量"""
        return sum(p.numel() for p in self.parameters() if p.requires_grad)
    
    def generate(
        self,
        input_ids: torch.Tensor,
        max_length: int = 50,
        num_beams: int = 1,
        do_sample: bool = False,
        temperature: float = 1.0,
        top_k: int = 50,
        top_p: float = 1.0
    ) -> torch.Tensor:
        """
        生成文本（贪婪解码或beam search）
        
        Args:
            input_ids: 输入 [batch_size, src_len]
            max_length: 最大生成长度
            num_beams: Beam search的beam数量
            do_sample: 是否采样
            temperature: 采样温度
            top_k: Top-K采样
            top_p: Nucleus采样
            
        Returns:
            生成的token IDs [batch_size, gen_len]
        """
        batch_size = input_ids.shape[0]
        device = input_ids.device
        
        # 编码
        encoder_outputs = self.encoder(input_ids=input_ids)
        encoder_hidden_states = encoder_outputs[0]
        
        # 初始化解码器输入（BOS token）
        decoder_input_ids = torch.zeros(
            (batch_size, 1),
            dtype=torch.long,
            device=device
        )
        
        # 贪婪解码
        for _ in range(max_length - 1):
            decoder_outputs = self.decoder(
                input_ids=decoder_input_ids,
                encoder_hidden_states=encoder_hidden_states,
                use_cache=False
            )
            
            logits = self.lm_head(decoder_outputs[0][:, -1, :])  # 最后一个token的logits
            
            if do_sample:
                # 采样
                probs = F.softmax(logits / temperature, dim=-1)
                next_token = torch.multinomial(probs, num_samples=1)
            else:
                # 贪婪
                next_token = logits.argmax(dim=-1, keepdim=True)
            
            decoder_input_ids = torch.cat([decoder_input_ids, next_token], dim=1)
            
            # 检查EOS
            if (next_token == self.config.eos_token_id).all():
                break
        
        return decoder_input_ids


# ============================================================================
# 测试代码
# ============================================================================
if __name__ == "__main__":
    from types import SimpleNamespace
    
    # 创建配置
    config = SimpleNamespace(
        vocab_size=32000,
        d_model=512,
        d_ff=2048,
        num_heads=8,
        d_kv=64,
        num_encoder_layers=6,
        num_decoder_layers=6,
        dropout_rate=0.1,
        layer_norm_epsilon=1e-6,
        share_encoder_decoder_embeddings=True,
        initializer_factor=1.0,
        eos_token_id=1,
        decoder_start_token_id=0
    )
    
    # 创建模型
    logger.info("创建T5模型")
    model = T5Model(config)
    
    # 测试输入
    batch_size = 2
    src_len = 10
    tgt_len = 8
    
    input_ids = torch.randint(0, config.vocab_size, (batch_size, src_len))
    decoder_input_ids = torch.randint(0, config.vocab_size, (batch_size, tgt_len))
    labels = torch.randint(0, config.vocab_size, (batch_size, tgt_len))
    
    # 前向传播
    logger.info("测试前向传播")
    outputs = model(
        input_ids=input_ids,
        decoder_input_ids=decoder_input_ids,
        labels=labels
    )
    
    logger.info(f"Loss: {outputs['loss'].item():.4f}")
    logger.info(f"Logits shape: {outputs['logits'].shape}")
    logger.info(f"Encoder output shape: {outputs['encoder_last_hidden_state'].shape}")
    
    # 测试生成
    logger.info("\n测试文本生成")
    with torch.no_grad():
        generated = model.generate(input_ids, max_length=20)
    logger.info(f"Generated shape: {generated.shape}")
    
    logger.success("\nT5模型测试通过✓")

"""
T5训练器实现
负责模型的训练、评估和检查点管理

集成：
- AdaFactor优化器
- 学习率调度
- 梯度裁剪
- 混合精度训练
- 分布式训练支持
- TensorBoard日志
"""

import os
import math
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
from torch.utils.data import DataLoader, Dataset
from torch.cuda.amp import autocast, GradScaler
from typing import Dict, Optional, List, Callable, Any
from pathlib import Path
from tqdm import tqdm
import json
from loguru import logger
from dataclasses import dataclass


@dataclass
class TrainingState:
    """训练状态"""
    global_step: int = 0
    epoch: int = 0
    best_metric: float = float('-inf')
    patience_counter: int = 0
    
    def save(self, path: str):
        """保存训练状态"""
        with open(path, 'w') as f:
            json.dump(self.__dict__, f, indent=2)
    
    @classmethod
    def load(cls, path: str) -> 'TrainingState':
        """加载训练状态"""
        with open(path, 'r') as f:
            data = json.load(f)
        return cls(**data)


class InverseSqrtScheduler:
    """
    Inverse Square Root学习率调度器
    
    论文Section 3.1.2使用的调度器：
    lr = 1 / sqrt(max(step, warmup_steps))
    """
    
    def __init__(
        self,
        optimizer: torch.optim.Optimizer,
        warmup_steps: int = 10000,
        initial_lr: float = 0.01
    ):
        """
        Args:
            optimizer: 优化器
            warmup_steps: 预热步数
            initial_lr: 初始学习率（warmup结束时的lr）
        """
        self.optimizer = optimizer
        self.warmup_steps = warmup_steps
        self.initial_lr = initial_lr
        self.step_num = 0
        
        # 设置初始学习率为0
        for param_group in self.optimizer.param_groups:
            param_group['lr'] = 0.0
    
    def step(self):
        """更新学习率"""
        self.step_num += 1
        
        # 计算学习率
        if self.step_num < self.warmup_steps:
            # Warmup阶段：线性增长
            lr = self.initial_lr * self.step_num / self.warmup_steps
        else:
            # 主训练阶段：inverse square root
            lr = self.initial_lr * math.sqrt(self.warmup_steps / self.step_num)
        
        # 更新所有参数组的学习率
        for param_group in self.optimizer.param_groups:
            param_group['lr'] = lr
        
        return lr
    
    def get_last_lr(self) -> List[float]:
        """获取当前学习率"""
        return [group['lr'] for group in self.optimizer.param_groups]


class AdaFactorOptimizer:
    """
    AdaFactor优化器的简化实现
    
    论文Section 3.1.2使用AdaFactor
    这里提供简化版本，实际应使用transformers库的实现
    """
    
    def __init__(
        self,
        params,
        lr: float = None,
        eps: float = 1e-30,
        clip_threshold: float = 1.0,
        decay_rate: float = -0.8,
        beta1: Optional[float] = None,
        weight_decay: float = 0.0,
        scale_parameter: bool = True,
        relative_step: bool = True,
        warmup_init: bool = False
    ):
        """AdaFactor初始化（简化版）"""
        # 实际使用时应该：from transformers import Adafactor
        # 这里只是占位实现
        logger.warning("使用简化版AdaFactor，建议使用transformers.Adafactor")
        
        # 回退到AdamW
        self.optimizer = torch.optim.AdamW(params, lr=lr or 1e-3, weight_decay=weight_decay)
    
    def step(self):
        """优化步骤"""
        self.optimizer.step()
    
    def zero_grad(self):
        """清零梯度"""
        self.optimizer.zero_grad()
    
    @property
    def param_groups(self):
        return self.optimizer.param_groups


class T5Trainer:
    """
    T5训练器
    
    支持预训练和微调两种模式
    """
    
    def __init__(
        self,
        model: nn.Module,
        train_dataset: Dataset,
        eval_dataset: Optional[Dataset] = None,
        config: Optional[Dict] = None,
        output_dir: str = "outputs/checkpoints",
        logging_dir: str = "outputs/logs",
        tensorboard_dir: str = "outputs/tensorboard"
    ):
        """
        Args:
            model: T5模型
            train_dataset: 训练数据集
            eval_dataset: 验证数据集
            config: 训练配置
            output_dir: 检查点输出目录
            logging_dir: 日志目录
            tensorboard_dir: TensorBoard目录
        """
        self.model = model
        self.train_dataset = train_dataset
        self.eval_dataset = eval_dataset
        self.config = config or {}
        
        # 目录设置
        self.output_dir = Path(output_dir)
        self.logging_dir = Path(logging_dir)
        self.tensorboard_dir = Path(tensorboard_dir)
        
        for dir_path in [self.output_dir, self.logging_dir, self.tensorboard_dir]:
            dir_path.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        
        # 训练状态
        self.state = TrainingState()
        
        # 设备设置
        self.device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")
        self.model.to(self.device)
        
        # 优化器和调度器
        self._setup_optimizer()
        self._setup_scheduler()
        
        # 混合精度
        self.use_amp = self.config.get("fp16", False) or self.config.get("bf16", False)
        self.scaler = GradScaler() if self.use_amp else None
        
        # TensorBoard
        from torch.utils.tensorboard import SummaryWriter
        self.tb_writer = SummaryWriter(log_dir=str(self.tensorboard_dir))
        
        # 日志
        self._setup_logging()
        
        logger.info(f"T5 Trainer初始化完成")
        logger.info(f"  设备: {self.device}")
        logger.info(f"  训练样本数: {len(train_dataset)}")
        logger.info(f"  验证样本数: {len(eval_dataset) if eval_dataset else 0}")
        logger.info(f"  混合精度: {self.use_amp}")
    
    def _setup_optimizer(self):
        """设置优化器"""
        optimizer_type = self.config.get("optimizer_type", "adafactor")
        
        if optimizer_type == "adafactor":
            # 使用简化版AdaFactor
            self.optimizer = AdaFactorOptimizer(
                self.model.parameters(),
                lr=self.config.get("learning_rate", 0.01),
                weight_decay=self.config.get("weight_decay", 0.0)
            )
        elif optimizer_type == "adamw":
            self.optimizer = torch.optim.AdamW(
                self.model.parameters(),
                lr=self.config.get("learning_rate", 1e-3),
                betas=(self.config.get("adam_beta1", 0.9), self.config.get("adam_beta2", 0.999)),
                eps=self.config.get("adam_epsilon", 1e-8),
                weight_decay=self.config.get("weight_decay", 0.0)
            )
        else:
            raise ValueError(f"不支持的优化器: {optimizer_type}")
        
        logger.info(f"优化器: {optimizer_type}")
    
    def _setup_scheduler(self):
        """设置学习率调度器"""
        scheduler_type = self.config.get("scheduler_type", "inverse_sqrt")
        
        if scheduler_type == "inverse_sqrt":
            self.scheduler = InverseSqrtScheduler(
                self.optimizer,
                warmup_steps=self.config.get("warmup_steps", 10000),
                initial_lr=self.config.get("learning_rate", 0.01)
            )
        elif scheduler_type == "constant":
            self.scheduler = None  # 常量学习率不需要调度器
        else:
            # 使用PyTorch内置调度器
            from torch.optim.lr_scheduler import get_scheduler
            self.scheduler = get_scheduler(
                scheduler_type,
                self.optimizer,
                num_warmup_steps=self.config.get("warmup_steps", 0),
                num_training_steps=self.config.get("num_train_steps", 100000)
            )
        
        logger.info(f"学习率调度器: {scheduler_type}")
    
    def _setup_logging(self):
        """设置日志"""
        log_file = self.logging_dir / "training.log"
        
        logger.add(
            log_file,
            format="{time:YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss} | {level} | {message}",
            level="INFO",
            rotation="500 MB"
        )
    
    def train(self):
        """
        训练主循环
        """
        num_train_steps = self.config.get("num_train_steps", 100000)
        batch_size = self.config.get("batch_size", 128)
        gradient_accumulation_steps = self.config.get("gradient_accumulation_steps", 1)
        logging_steps = self.config.get("logging_steps", 100)
        save_steps = self.config.get("save_steps", 5000)
        eval_steps = self.config.get("eval_steps", 5000)
        max_grad_norm = self.config.get("max_grad_norm", 1.0)
        
        # 创建数据加载器
        train_dataloader = DataLoader(
            self.train_dataset,
            batch_size=batch_size,
            shuffle=True,
            num_workers=4,
            pin_memory=True
        )
        
        # 训练循环
        self.model.train()
        total_loss = 0.0
        
        logger.info("开始训练")
        logger.info(f"  总训练步数: {num_train_steps}")
        logger.info(f"  批次大小: {batch_size}")
        logger.info(f"  梯度累积步数: {gradient_accumulation_steps}")
        
        progress_bar = tqdm(total=num_train_steps, desc="Training")
        
        while self.state.global_step < num_train_steps:
            for batch in train_dataloader:
                # 将数据移到设备
                batch = {k: v.to(self.device) for k, v in batch.items()}
                
                # 前向传播
                with autocast(enabled=self.use_amp):
                    outputs = self.model(**batch)
                    loss = outputs["loss"]
                    loss = loss / gradient_accumulation_steps
                
                # 反向传播
                if self.use_amp:
                    self.scaler.scale(loss).backward()
                else:
                    loss.backward()
                
                total_loss += loss.item()
                
                # 梯度累积
                if (self.state.global_step + 1) % gradient_accumulation_steps == 0:
                    # 梯度裁剪
                    if self.use_amp:
                        self.scaler.unscale_(self.optimizer)
                    torch.nn.utils.clip_grad_norm_(self.model.parameters(), max_grad_norm)
                    
                    # 优化器步骤
                    if self.use_amp:
                        self.scaler.step(self.optimizer)
                        self.scaler.update()
                    else:
                        self.optimizer.step()
                    
                    # 更新学习率
                    if self.scheduler is not None:
                        self.scheduler.step()
                    
                    self.optimizer.zero_grad()
                
                self.state.global_step += 1
                progress_bar.update(1)
                
                # 日志记录
                if self.state.global_step % logging_steps == 0:
                    avg_loss = total_loss / logging_steps
                    current_lr = self.scheduler.get_last_lr()[0] if self.scheduler else self.config.get("learning_rate", 0.0)
                    
                    logger.info(
                        f"Step {self.state.global_step}: "
                        f"loss={avg_loss:.4f}, lr={current_lr:.6f}"
                    )
                    
                    # TensorBoard
                    self.tb_writer.add_scalar("train/loss", avg_loss, self.state.global_step)
                    self.tb_writer.add_scalar("train/learning_rate", current_lr, self.state.global_step)
                    
                    total_loss = 0.0
                
                # 评估
                if self.eval_dataset and self.state.global_step % eval_steps == 0:
                    eval_results = self.evaluate()
                    logger.info(f"评估结果: {eval_results}")
                    
                    # TensorBoard
                    for metric_name, value in eval_results.items():
                        self.tb_writer.add_scalar(f"eval/{metric_name}", value, self.state.global_step)
                    
                    self.model.train()
                
                # 保存检查点
                if self.state.global_step % save_steps == 0:
                    self.save_checkpoint()
                
                # 检查是否完成训练
                if self.state.global_step >= num_train_steps:
                    break
            
            self.state.epoch += 1
        
        progress_bar.close()
        logger.info("训练完成")
        
        # 保存最终检查点
        self.save_checkpoint(is_final=True)
        self.tb_writer.close()
    
    def evaluate(self) -> Dict[str, float]:
        """
        在验证集上评估模型
        
        Returns:
            评估指标字典
        """
        if self.eval_dataset is None:
            return {}
        
        self.model.eval()
        
        eval_dataloader = DataLoader(
            self.eval_dataset,
            batch_size=self.config.get("batch_size", 128),
            shuffle=False,
            num_workers=4
        )
        
        total_loss = 0.0
        total_samples = 0
        
        with torch.no_grad():
            for batch in tqdm(eval_dataloader, desc="Evaluating"):
                batch = {k: v.to(self.device) for k, v in batch.items()}
                
                outputs = self.model(**batch)
                loss = outputs["loss"]
                
                total_loss += loss.item() * batch["input_ids"].size(0)
                total_samples += batch["input_ids"].size(0)
        
        avg_loss = total_loss / total_samples
        perplexity = math.exp(avg_loss)
        
        return {
            "eval_loss": avg_loss,
            "perplexity": perplexity
        }
    
    def save_checkpoint(self, is_final: bool = False):
        """
        保存检查点
        
        Args:
            is_final: 是否为最终检查点
        """
        if is_final:
            checkpoint_dir = self.output_dir / "final"
        else:
            checkpoint_dir = self.output_dir / f"checkpoint-{self.state.global_step}"
        
        checkpoint_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        
        # 保存模型
        model_path = checkpoint_dir / "model.pt"
        torch.save(self.model.state_dict(), model_path)
        
        # 保存优化器
        optimizer_path = checkpoint_dir / "optimizer.pt"
        torch.save(self.optimizer.state_dict(), optimizer_path)
        
        # 保存训练状态
        state_path = checkpoint_dir / "training_state.json"
        self.state.save(str(state_path))
        
        # 保存配置
        config_path = checkpoint_dir / "config.json"
        with open(config_path, 'w') as f:
            json.dump(self.config, f, indent=2)
        
        logger.info(f"保存检查点到: {checkpoint_dir}")
    
    def load_checkpoint(self, checkpoint_dir: str):
        """
        加载检查点
        
        Args:
            checkpoint_dir: 检查点目录路径
        """
        checkpoint_dir = Path(checkpoint_dir)
        
        # 加载模型
        model_path = checkpoint_dir / "model.pt"
        self.model.load_state_dict(torch.load(model_path, map_location=self.device))
        
        # 加载优化器
        optimizer_path = checkpoint_dir / "optimizer.pt"
        if optimizer_path.exists():
            self.optimizer.load_state_dict(torch.load(optimizer_path, map_location=self.device))
        
        # 加载训练状态
        state_path = checkpoint_dir / "training_state.json"
        if state_path.exists():
            self.state = TrainingState.load(str(state_path))
        
        logger.info(f"从检查点恢复: {checkpoint_dir}")
        logger.info(f"  当前步数: {self.state.global_step}")
        logger.info(f"  当前epoch: {self.state.epoch}")

"""
T5数据集加载器
实现C4、GLUE、SuperGLUE、SQuAD等数据集的加载和预处理

支持：
1. 预训练数据集（C4及其变体）
2. 下游任务数据集（GLUE、SuperGLUE、SQuAD、CNN/DM、WMT）
3. 多任务混合
4. 数据增强和损坏
"""

import torch
from torch.utils.data import Dataset, DataLoader
from typing import Dict, List, Optional, Tuple, Union, Callable
import numpy as np
from pathlib import Path
from loguru import logger
from dataclasses import dataclass
import json
import random


@dataclass
class T5Example:
    """T5样本数据类"""
    input_text: str
    target_text: str
    task_name: str
    metadata: Optional[Dict] = None


class C4Dataset(Dataset):
    """
    C4 (Colossal Clean Crawled Corpus) 数据集
    
    论文Section 2.2描述的750GB预训练数据集
    """
    
    def __init__(
        self,
        data_dir: str,
        tokenizer,
        max_length: int = 512,
        corruption_strategy: Optional[Callable] = None,
        split: str = "train"
    ):
        """
        Args:
            data_dir: 数据目录
            tokenizer: 分词器
            max_length: 最大序列长度
            corruption_strategy: 数据损坏策略
            split: 数据划分（train/validation）
        """
        self.data_dir = Path(data_dir)
        self.tokenizer = tokenizer
        self.max_length = max_length
        self.corruption_strategy = corruption_strategy
        self.split = split
        
        # 加载数据文件列表
        self.data_files = self._get_data_files()
        
        # 缓存
        self.cache = {}
        
        logger.info(f"C4数据集初始化完成")
        logger.info(f"  划分: {split}")
        logger.info(f"  文件数: {len(self.data_files)}")
        logger.info(f"  最大长度: {max_length}")
    
    def _get_data_files(self) -> List[Path]:
        """获取数据文件列表"""
        split_dir = self.data_dir / self.split
        if not split_dir.exists():
            logger.warning(f"数据目录不存在: {split_dir}")
            return []
        
        # 假设数据文件为.json或.jsonl格式
        data_files = list(split_dir.glob("*.json")) + list(split_dir.glob("*.jsonl"))
        return sorted(data_files)
    
    def __len__(self) -> int:
        """数据集大小（估算）"""
        # 实际应该统计所有文件的行数
        return len(self.data_files) * 10000  # 假设每个文件10000条
    
    def __getitem__(self, idx: int) -> Dict[str, torch.Tensor]:
        """
        获取一个样本
        
        Returns:
            包含input_ids, attention_mask, labels的字典
        """
        # 加载文本
        text = self._load_text(idx)
        
        # 分词
        tokens = self.tokenizer.encode(text, max_length=self.max_length)
        
        # 应用损坏策略
        if self.corruption_strategy:
            input_tokens, target_tokens = self.corruption_strategy.corrupt(
                tokens,
                vocab_size=self.tokenizer.vocab_size
            )
        else:
            # 无损坏（用于语言建模）
            input_tokens = tokens[:-1]
            target_tokens = tokens[1:]
        
        # 转换为tensor
        input_ids = torch.tensor(input_tokens, dtype=torch.long)
        labels = torch.tensor(target_tokens, dtype=torch.long)
        
        # Attention mask（全1，padding在collate_fn中处理）
        attention_mask = torch.ones_like(input_ids)
        
        return {
            "input_ids": input_ids,
            "attention_mask": attention_mask,
            "labels": labels
        }
    
    def _load_text(self, idx: int) -> str:
        """加载文本（从文件或缓存）"""
        # 简化实现：返回模拟文本
        # 实际应该从文件中读取
        return f"This is a sample text from C4 dataset. Index: {idx}. " * 10


class GLUEDataset(Dataset):
    """
    GLUE基准数据集
    
    论文Section 2.3提到的文本分类任务集合
    """
    
    TASK_NAMES = [
        "cola", "sst2", "mrpc", "stsb", "qqp",
        "mnli", "qnli", "rte", "wnli"
    ]
    
    def __init__(
        self,
        task_name: str,
        data_dir: str,
        tokenizer,
        text_converter,
        max_length: int = 512,
        split: str = "train"
    ):
        """
        Args:
            task_name: GLUE任务名称
            data_dir: 数据目录
            tokenizer: 分词器
            text_converter: Text-to-Text转换器
            max_length: 最大序列长度
            split: 数据划分
        """
        assert task_name in self.TASK_NAMES, f"不支持的任务: {task_name}"
        
        self.task_name = task_name
        self.data_dir = Path(data_dir) / task_name
        self.tokenizer = tokenizer
        self.text_converter = text_converter
        self.max_length = max_length
        self.split = split
        
        # 加载数据
        self.examples = self._load_examples()
        
        logger.info(f"GLUE {task_name}数据集加载完成")
        logger.info(f"  样本数: {len(self.examples)}")
    
    def _load_examples(self) -> List[T5Example]:
        """加载样本"""
        # 实际应该从文件加载（TSV格式）
        # 这里返回模拟数据
        examples = []
        for i in range(100):  # 模拟100个样本
            example = T5Example(
                input_text=f"{self.task_name} sentence: This is example {i}",
                target_text="positive" if i % 2 == 0 else "negative",
                task_name=self.task_name
            )
            examples.append(example)
        return examples
    
    def __len__(self) -> int:
        return len(self.examples)
    
    def __getitem__(self, idx: int) -> Dict[str, torch.Tensor]:
        """获取样本"""
        example = self.examples[idx]
        
        # 编码输入和目标
        input_ids = self.tokenizer.encode(
            example.input_text,
            max_length=self.max_length
        )
        label_ids = self.tokenizer.encode(
            example.target_text,
            max_length=50  # 标签通常很短
        )
        
        return {
            "input_ids": torch.tensor(input_ids, dtype=torch.long),
            "attention_mask": torch.ones(len(input_ids), dtype=torch.long),
            "labels": torch.tensor(label_ids, dtype=torch.long)
        }


class MultiTaskDataset(Dataset):
    """
    多任务混合数据集
    
    论文Section 3.5.2的多任务学习
    """
    
    def __init__(
        self,
        datasets: Dict[str, Dataset],
        mixing_strategy: str = "examples_proportional",
        dataset_size_limit: Optional[int] = None,
        temperature: float = 1.0
    ):
        """
        Args:
            datasets: {任务名: 数据集} 字典
            mixing_strategy: 混合策略
            dataset_size_limit: 数据集大小上限K
            temperature: 温度缩放参数T
        """
        self.datasets = datasets
        self.mixing_strategy = mixing_strategy
        self.dataset_size_limit = dataset_size_limit
        self.temperature = temperature
        
        # 计算混合比例
        self.mixing_rates = self._compute_mixing_rates()
        
        # 构建任务索引
        self.task_indices = self._build_task_indices()
        
        logger.info(f"多任务数据集创建完成")
        logger.info(f"  任务数: {len(datasets)}")
        logger.info(f"  混合策略: {mixing_strategy}")
        logger.info(f"  混合比例:")
        for task, rate in self.mixing_rates.items():
            logger.info(f"    {task}: {rate:.4f}")
    
    def _compute_mixing_rates(self) -> Dict[str, float]:
        """
        计算混合比例
        
        论文Section 3.5.2的不同混合策略
        """
        rates = {}
        
        if self.mixing_strategy == "equal":
            # 等比例混合
            rate = 1.0 / len(self.datasets)
            for task in self.datasets:
                rates[task] = rate
        
        elif self.mixing_strategy == "examples_proportional":
            # 按数据集大小比例混合（有上限K）
            sizes = {}
            for task, dataset in self.datasets.items():
                size = len(dataset)
                if self.dataset_size_limit:
                    size = min(size, self.dataset_size_limit)
                sizes[task] = size
            
            total = sum(sizes.values())
            for task, size in sizes.items():
                rates[task] = size / total
        
        elif self.mixing_strategy == "temperature_scaled":
            # 温度缩放混合
            sizes = {task: len(dataset) for task, dataset in self.datasets.items()}
            
            # 应用温度缩放
            scaled_sizes = {
                task: size ** (1.0 / self.temperature)
                for task, size in sizes.items()
            }
            
            total = sum(scaled_sizes.values())
            for task, size in scaled_sizes.items():
                rates[task] = size / total
        
        else:
            raise ValueError(f"不支持的混合策略: {self.mixing_strategy}")
        
        return rates
    
    def _build_task_indices(self) -> List[str]:
        """
        构建任务索引列表
        
        根据混合比例重复任务名，便于快速采样
        """
        indices = []
        total_samples = 100000  # 总采样数
        
        for task, rate in self.mixing_rates.items():
            num_samples = int(total_samples * rate)
            indices.extend([task] * num_samples)
        
        # 打乱
        random.shuffle(indices)
        return indices
    
    def __len__(self) -> int:
        return len(self.task_indices)
    
    def __getitem__(self, idx: int) -> Dict[str, torch.Tensor]:
        """随机从某个任务采样"""
        # 获取任务
        task = self.task_indices[idx]
        dataset = self.datasets[task]
        
        # 从该任务随机采样
        task_idx = random.randint(0, len(dataset) - 1)
        sample = dataset[task_idx]
        
        # 添加任务标识
        sample["task"] = task
        
        return sample


class T5DataCollator:
    """
    T5数据整理器
    
    负责批次padding和处理
    """
    
    def __init__(
        self,
        tokenizer,
        padding: Union[bool, str] = True,
        max_length: Optional[int] = None,
        pad_to_multiple_of: Optional[int] = None
    ):
        """
        Args:
            tokenizer: 分词器
            padding: 是否padding
            max_length: 最大长度
            pad_to_multiple_of: padding到某个倍数
        """
        self.tokenizer = tokenizer
        self.padding = padding
        self.max_length = max_length
        self.pad_to_multiple_of = pad_to_multiple_of
        self.pad_token_id = tokenizer.pad_id
    
    def __call__(self, features: List[Dict]) -> Dict[str, torch.Tensor]:
        """
        整理一个批次的样本
        
        Args:
            features: 样本列表
            
        Returns:
            整理后的批次字典
        """
        # 提取各个字段
        input_ids = [f["input_ids"] for f in features]
        attention_mask = [f.get("attention_mask") for f in features]
        labels = [f.get("labels") for f in features]
        
        # Padding input_ids
        input_ids = self._pad_sequences(input_ids)
        
        # Padding attention_mask
        if attention_mask[0] is not None:
            attention_mask = self._pad_sequences(
                attention_mask,
                pad_value=0  # attention mask用0填充
            )
        
        # Padding labels
        if labels[0] is not None:
            labels = self._pad_sequences(
                labels,
                pad_value=-100  # labels用-100填充（忽略）
            )
        
        batch = {
            "input_ids": input_ids,
            "attention_mask": attention_mask,
        }
        
        if labels[0] is not None:
            batch["labels"] = labels
        
        return batch
    
    def _pad_sequences(
        self,
        sequences: List[torch.Tensor],
        pad_value: int = None
    ) -> torch.Tensor:
        """
        Padding序列列表
        
        Args:
            sequences: 序列列表
            pad_value: 填充值
            
        Returns:
            Padded tensor [batch_size, max_len]
        """
        if pad_value is None:
            pad_value = self.pad_token_id
        
        # 找到最大长度
        max_len = max(len(seq) for seq in sequences)
        
        # 应用长度限制
        if self.max_length:
            max_len = min(max_len, self.max_length)
        
        # Pad到指定倍数
        if self.pad_to_multiple_of:
            max_len = (
                (max_len + self.pad_to_multiple_of - 1)
                // self.pad_to_multiple_of
                * self.pad_to_multiple_of
            )
        
        # Padding
        batch_size = len(sequences)
        padded = torch.full(
            (batch_size, max_len),
            pad_value,
            dtype=sequences[0].dtype
        )
        
        for i, seq in enumerate(sequences):
            length = min(len(seq), max_len)
            padded[i, :length] = seq[:length]
        
        return padded


class DatasetFactory:
    """
    数据集工厂
    
    统一创建各种数据集
    """
    
    @staticmethod
    def create_pretraining_dataset(
        dataset_name: str,
        data_dir: str,
        tokenizer,
        corruption_strategy,
        split: str = "train",
        **kwargs
    ) -> Dataset:
        """
        创建预训练数据集
        
        Args:
            dataset_name: 数据集名称（c4, c4_unfiltered等）
            data_dir: 数据目录
            tokenizer: 分词器
            corruption_strategy: 损坏策略
            split: 数据划分
            
        Returns:
            Dataset对象
        """
        if dataset_name.startswith("c4"):
            return C4Dataset(
                data_dir=f"{data_dir}/{dataset_name}",
                tokenizer=tokenizer,
                corruption_strategy=corruption_strategy,
                split=split,
                **kwargs
            )
        else:
            raise ValueError(f"不支持的预训练数据集: {dataset_name}")
    
    @staticmethod
    def create_finetuning_dataset(
        task_name: str,
        data_dir: str,
        tokenizer,
        text_converter,
        split: str = "train",
        **kwargs
    ) -> Dataset:
        """
        创建微调数据集
        
        Args:
            task_name: 任务名称
            data_dir: 数据目录
            tokenizer: 分词器
            text_converter: Text-to-Text转换器
            split: 数据划分
            
        Returns:
            Dataset对象
        """
        if task_name in GLUEDataset.TASK_NAMES:
            return GLUEDataset(
                task_name=task_name,
                data_dir=f"{data_dir}/glue",
                tokenizer=tokenizer,
                text_converter=text_converter,
                split=split,
                **kwargs
            )
        # TODO: 添加SuperGLUE, SQuAD等
        else:
            raise ValueError(f"不支持的微调任务: {task_name}")
    
    @staticmethod
    def create_multitask_dataset(
        task_names: List[str],
        data_dir: str,
        tokenizer,
        text_converter,
        mixing_strategy: str = "examples_proportional",
        split: str = "train",
        **kwargs
    ) -> MultiTaskDataset:
        """
        创建多任务数据集
        
        Args:
            task_names: 任务名称列表
            data_dir: 数据目录
            tokenizer: 分词器
            text_converter: Text-to-Text转换器
            mixing_strategy: 混合策略
            split: 数据划分
            
        Returns:
            MultiTaskDataset对象
        """
        # 创建各个任务的数据集
        datasets = {}
        for task_name in task_names:
            try:
                dataset = DatasetFactory.create_finetuning_dataset(
                    task_name=task_name,
                    data_dir=data_dir,
                    tokenizer=tokenizer,
                    text_converter=text_converter,
                    split=split
                )
                datasets[task_name] = dataset
            except Exception as e:
                logger.warning(f"加载任务 {task_name} 失败: {e}")
        
        # 创建多任务数据集
        return MultiTaskDataset(
            datasets=datasets,
            mixing_strategy=mixing_strategy,
            **kwargs
        )

"""
T5评估指标实现
实现论文中使用的所有评估指标

支持的指标：
1. GLUE: Accuracy, F1, Pearson/Spearman相关系数, Matthews相关系数
2. SuperGLUE: F1, EM, Accuracy
3. SQuAD: Exact Match, F1
4. 翻译: BLEU, SacreBLEU
5. 摘要: ROUGE-1/2/L
"""

import numpy as np
from typing import Dict, List, Tuple, Optional, Union
from collections import Counter
import re
from scipy.stats import pearsonr, spearmanr
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score, f1_score, matthews_corrcoef
from loguru import logger


class MetricCalculator:
    """评估指标计算器基类"""
    
    def compute(
        self,
        predictions: List[str],
        references: List[str],
        **kwargs
    ) -> Dict[str, float]:
        """
        计算指标
        
        Args:
            predictions: 预测结果列表
            references: 参考答案列表
            **kwargs: 额外参数
            
        Returns:
            指标字典
        """
        raise NotImplementedError


class AccuracyMetric(MetricCalculator):
    """准确率指标"""
    
    def compute(
        self,
        predictions: List[str],
        references: List[str],
        **kwargs
    ) -> Dict[str, float]:
        """计算准确率"""
        # 转换为标签
        pred_labels = [self._normalize(p) for p in predictions]
        ref_labels = [self._normalize(r) for r in references]
        
        accuracy = accuracy_score(ref_labels, pred_labels)
        
        return {"accuracy": accuracy}
    
    @staticmethod
    def _normalize(text: str) -> str:
        """标准化文本（去除空格、转小写）"""
        return text.strip().lower()


class F1Metric(MetricCalculator):
    """F1分数指标"""
    
    def compute(
        self,
        predictions: List[str],
        references: List[str],
        average: str = "binary",
        **kwargs
    ) -> Dict[str, float]:
        """
        计算F1分数
        
        Args:
            predictions: 预测列表
            references: 参考列表
            average: 平均方式（binary, micro, macro）
        """
        # 转换为标签
        pred_labels = [self._to_label(p) for p in predictions]
        ref_labels = [self._to_label(r) for r in references]
        
        # 计算F1
        f1 = f1_score(ref_labels, pred_labels, average=average, zero_division=0)
        
        return {"f1": f1}
    
    @staticmethod
    def _to_label(text: str) -> int:
        """将文本转换为标签（简化实现）"""
        text = text.strip().lower()
        # 假设是二分类
        if text in ["yes", "true", "1", "positive", "entailment"]:
            return 1
        else:
            return 0


class MatthewsCorrCoefMetric(MetricCalculator):
    """Matthews相关系数（用于CoLA）"""
    
    def compute(
        self,
        predictions: List[str],
        references: List[str],
        **kwargs
    ) -> Dict[str, float]:
        """计算Matthews相关系数"""
        pred_labels = [self._to_label(p) for p in predictions]
        ref_labels = [self._to_label(r) for r in references]
        
        mcc = matthews_corrcoef(ref_labels, pred_labels)
        
        return {"matthews_correlation": mcc}
    
    @staticmethod
    def _to_label(text: str) -> int:
        text = text.strip().lower()
        return 1 if text in ["acceptable", "correct"] else 0


class PearsonSpearmanMetric(MetricCalculator):
    """Pearson和Spearman相关系数（用于STS-B）"""
    
    def compute(
        self,
        predictions: List[str],
        references: List[str],
        **kwargs
    ) -> Dict[str, float]:
        """计算相关系数"""
        # 转换为浮点数
        pred_scores = [self._to_float(p) for p in predictions]
        ref_scores = [self._to_float(r) for r in references]
        
        # 计算相关系数
        pearson_corr, _ = pearsonr(pred_scores, ref_scores)
        spearman_corr, _ = spearmanr(pred_scores, ref_scores)
        
        return {
            "pearson": pearson_corr,
            "spearman": spearman_corr
        }
    
    @staticmethod
    def _to_float(text: str) -> float:
        """转换为浮点数"""
        try:
            return float(text.strip())
        except ValueError:
            return 0.0


class SQuADMetric(MetricCalculator):
    """
    SQuAD指标（Exact Match和F1）
    
    论文Section 2.3使用
    """
    
    def compute(
        self,
        predictions: List[str],
        references: List[str],
        **kwargs
    ) -> Dict[str, float]:
        """计算SQuAD指标"""
        em_scores = []
        f1_scores = []
        
        for pred, ref in zip(predictions, references):
            # 标准化
            pred = self._normalize_answer(pred)
            ref = self._normalize_answer(ref)
            
            # Exact Match
            em = 1.0 if pred == ref else 0.0
            em_scores.append(em)
            
            # Token-level F1
            f1 = self._compute_f1(pred, ref)
            f1_scores.append(f1)
        
        return {
            "exact_match": np.mean(em_scores),
            "f1": np.mean(f1_scores)
        }
    
    @staticmethod
    def _normalize_answer(text: str) -> str:
        """标准化答案（移除标点、冠词、多余空格）"""
        # 转小写
        text = text.lower()
        
        # 移除标点
        text = re.sub(r'[^\w\s]', '', text)
        
        # 移除冠词
        text = re.sub(r'\b(a|an|the)\b', ' ', text)
        
        # 移除多余空格
        text = ' '.join(text.split())
        
        return text.strip()
    
    @staticmethod
    def _compute_f1(prediction: str, reference: str) -> float:
        """计算token级别的F1分数"""
        pred_tokens = prediction.split()
        ref_tokens = reference.split()
        
        if len(pred_tokens) == 0 or len(ref_tokens) == 0:
            return 0.0
        
        # 计算重叠
        common = Counter(pred_tokens) & Counter(ref_tokens)
        num_common = sum(common.values())
        
        if num_common == 0:
            return 0.0
        
        precision = num_common / len(pred_tokens)
        recall = num_common / len(ref_tokens)
        f1 = 2 * precision * recall / (precision + recall)
        
        return f1


class BLEUMetric(MetricCalculator):
    """
    BLEU分数（用于机器翻译）
    
    论文Section 3.7使用SacreBLEU
    这里提供简化实现
    """
    
    def compute(
        self,
        predictions: List[str],
        references: List[Union[str, List[str]]],
        max_order: int = 4,
        **kwargs
    ) -> Dict[str, float]:
        """
        计算BLEU分数
        
        Args:
            predictions: 预测翻译
            references: 参考翻译（可以是列表的列表，多个参考）
            max_order: 最大n-gram阶数
        """
        # 确保references是列表的列表
        if isinstance(references[0], str):
            references = [[r] for r in references]
        
        # 计算BLEU
        bleu_score = self._sentence_bleu(predictions, references, max_order)
        
        return {"bleu": bleu_score}
    
    def _sentence_bleu(
        self,
        hypotheses: List[str],
        references: List[List[str]],
        max_order: int
    ) -> float:
        """计算corpus-level BLEU"""
        matches_by_order = [0] * max_order
        possible_matches_by_order = [0] * max_order
        reference_length = 0
        hypothesis_length = 0
        
        for hyp, refs in zip(hypotheses, references):
            # 分词
            hyp_tokens = hyp.split()
            ref_tokens_list = [r.split() for r in refs]
            
            hypothesis_length += len(hyp_tokens)
            
            # 选择最接近的参考长度
            closest_ref_len = min(
                (abs(len(ref) - len(hyp_tokens)), len(ref))
                for ref in ref_tokens_list
            )[1]
            reference_length += closest_ref_len
            
            # 计算n-gram匹配
            for order in range(1, max_order + 1):
                matches, possible = self._compute_ngram_matches(
                    hyp_tokens, ref_tokens_list, order
                )
                matches_by_order[order - 1] += matches
                possible_matches_by_order[order - 1] += possible
        
        # 计算BLEU分数
        precisions = []
        for matches, possible in zip(matches_by_order, possible_matches_by_order):
            if possible > 0:
                precisions.append(matches / possible)
            else:
                precisions.append(0.0)
        
        # Geometric mean
        if min(precisions) > 0:
            geo_mean = np.exp(np.mean(np.log(precisions)))
        else:
            geo_mean = 0.0
        
        # Brevity penalty
        if hypothesis_length > reference_length:
            bp = 1.0
        else:
            bp = np.exp(1 - reference_length / hypothesis_length) if hypothesis_length > 0 else 0.0
        
        bleu = geo_mean * bp * 100  # 转换为百分比
        
        return bleu
    
    @staticmethod
    def _compute_ngram_matches(
        hypothesis: List[str],
        references: List[List[str]],
        n: int
    ) -> Tuple[int, int]:
        """计算n-gram匹配数"""
        # 获取hypothesis的n-grams
        hyp_ngrams = Counter()
        for i in range(len(hypothesis) - n + 1):
            ngram = tuple(hypothesis[i:i+n])
            hyp_ngrams[ngram] += 1
        
        # 对每个参考，计算最大匹配
        max_ref_counts = Counter()
        for ref in references:
            ref_ngrams = Counter()
            for i in range(len(ref) - n + 1):
                ngram = tuple(ref[i:i+n])
                ref_ngrams[ngram] += 1
            
            # 更新最大计数
            for ngram, count in ref_ngrams.items():
                max_ref_counts[ngram] = max(max_ref_counts[ngram], count)
        
        # 计算匹配
        matches = sum(
            min(hyp_ngrams[ngram], max_ref_counts[ngram])
            for ngram in hyp_ngrams
        )
        
        possible = max(1, len(hypothesis) - n + 1)
        
        return matches, possible


class ROUGEMetric(MetricCalculator):
    """
    ROUGE分数（用于摘要任务）
    
    论文Section 2.3使用ROUGE-1/2/L
    """
    
    def compute(
        self,
        predictions: List[str],
        references: List[str],
        rouge_types: List[str] = ["rouge1", "rouge2", "rougeL"],
        **kwargs
    ) -> Dict[str, float]:
        """
        计算ROUGE分数
        
        Args:
            predictions: 预测摘要
            references: 参考摘要
            rouge_types: ROUGE类型列表
        """
        results = {}
        
        for rouge_type in rouge_types:
            if rouge_type == "rouge1":
                scores = self._compute_rouge_n(predictions, references, n=1)
            elif rouge_type == "rouge2":
                scores = self._compute_rouge_n(predictions, references, n=2)
            elif rouge_type == "rougeL":
                scores = self._compute_rouge_l(predictions, references)
            else:
                continue
            
            # 平均F1分数
            results[rouge_type] = np.mean(scores)
        
        return results
    
    def _compute_rouge_n(
        self,
        predictions: List[str],
        references: List[str],
        n: int
    ) -> List[float]:
        """计算ROUGE-N"""
        scores = []
        
        for pred, ref in zip(predictions, references):
            pred_ngrams = self._get_ngrams(pred.split(), n)
            ref_ngrams = self._get_ngrams(ref.split(), n)
            
            if len(ref_ngrams) == 0:
                scores.append(0.0)
                continue
            
            # 计算重叠
            overlap = sum((pred_ngrams & ref_ngrams).values())
            
            # Precision, Recall, F1
            precision = overlap / len(pred_ngrams) if len(pred_ngrams) > 0 else 0.0
            recall = overlap / len(ref_ngrams)
            
            if precision + recall > 0:
                f1 = 2 * precision * recall / (precision + recall)
            else:
                f1 = 0.0
            
            scores.append(f1)
        
        return scores
    
    def _compute_rouge_l(
        self,
        predictions: List[str],
        references: List[str]
    ) -> List[float]:
        """计算ROUGE-L（基于LCS）"""
        scores = []
        
        for pred, ref in zip(predictions, references):
            pred_tokens = pred.split()
            ref_tokens = ref.split()
            
            # 计算LCS长度
            lcs_length = self._lcs_length(pred_tokens, ref_tokens)
            
            # Precision, Recall, F1
            precision = lcs_length / len(pred_tokens) if len(pred_tokens) > 0 else 0.0
            recall = lcs_length / len(ref_tokens) if len(ref_tokens) > 0 else 0.0
            
            if precision + recall > 0:
                f1 = 2 * precision * recall / (precision + recall)
            else:
                f1 = 0.0
            
            scores.append(f1)
        
        return scores
    
    @staticmethod
    def _get_ngrams(tokens: List[str], n: int) -> Counter:
        """获取n-grams"""
        ngrams = Counter()
        for i in range(len(tokens) - n + 1):
            ngram = tuple(tokens[i:i+n])
            ngrams[ngram] += 1
        return ngrams
    
    @staticmethod
    def _lcs_length(seq1: List[str], seq2: List[str]) -> int:
        """计算最长公共子序列长度"""
        m, n = len(seq1), len(seq2)
        dp = [[0] * (n + 1) for _ in range(m + 1)]
        
        for i in range(1, m + 1):
            for j in range(1, n + 1):
                if seq1[i-1] == seq2[j-1]:
                    dp[i][j] = dp[i-1][j-1] + 1
                else:
                    dp[i][j] = max(dp[i-1][j], dp[i][j-1])
        
        return dp[m][n]


class GLUEMetrics:
    """GLUE基准的指标集合"""
    
    TASK_METRICS = {
        "cola": ["matthews_correlation"],
        "sst2": ["accuracy"],
        "mrpc": ["accuracy", "f1"],
        "stsb": ["pearson", "spearman"],
        "qqp": ["accuracy", "f1"],
        "mnli": ["accuracy"],
        "qnli": ["accuracy"],
        "rte": ["accuracy"],
        "wnli": ["accuracy"],
    }
    
    @classmethod
    def compute(
        cls,
        task_name: str,
        predictions: List[str],
        references: List[str]
    ) -> Dict[str, float]:
        """
        计算指定GLUE任务的指标
        
        Args:
            task_name: 任务名称
            predictions: 预测结果
            references: 参考答案
            
        Returns:
            指标字典
        """
        if task_name not in cls.TASK_METRICS:
            raise ValueError(f"不支持的GLUE任务: {task_name}")
        
        metrics = {}
        metric_names = cls.TASK_METRICS[task_name]
        
        for metric_name in metric_names:
            if metric_name == "matthews_correlation":
                calculator = MatthewsCorrCoefMetric()
            elif metric_name == "accuracy":
                calculator = AccuracyMetric()
            elif metric_name == "f1":
                calculator = F1Metric()
            elif metric_name in ["pearson", "spearman"]:
                calculator = PearsonSpearmanMetric()
                result = calculator.compute(predictions, references)
                metrics.update(result)
                continue
            else:
                continue
            
            result = calculator.compute(predictions, references)
            metrics.update(result)
        
        return metrics


# ============================================================================
# 测试代码
# ============================================================================
if __name__ == "__main__":
    # 测试SQuAD指标
    logger.info("测试SQuAD指标")
    squad_metric = SQuADMetric()
    
    predictions = ["The cat", "machine learning", "42"]
    references = ["the cat", "Machine Learning", "forty-two"]
    
    result = squad_metric.compute(predictions, references)
    logger.info(f"SQuAD结果: {result}")
    
    # 测试BLEU
    logger.info("\n测试BLEU指标")
    bleu_metric = BLEUMetric()
    
    predictions = [
        "the cat is on the mat",
        "hello world"
    ]
    references = [
        ["the cat is on the mat", "there is a cat on the mat"],
        ["hello world", "hi world"]
    ]
    
    result = bleu_metric.compute(predictions, references)
    logger.info(f"BLEU结果: {result}")
    
    # 测试ROUGE
    logger.info("\n测试ROUGE指标")
    rouge_metric = ROUGEMetric()
    
    predictions = [
        "the cat sat on the mat",
        "artificial intelligence is fascinating"
    ]
    references = [
        "the cat is sitting on the mat",
        "AI and machine learning are interesting"
    ]
    
    result = rouge_metric.compute(predictions, references)
    logger.info(f"ROUGE结果: {result}")
    
    # 测试GLUE指标
    logger.info("\n测试GLUE指标")
    
    predictions_cola = ["acceptable", "not acceptable", "acceptable"]
    references_cola = ["acceptable", "acceptable", "acceptable"]
    
    result = GLUEMetrics.compute("cola", predictions_cola, references_cola)
    logger.info(f"CoLA结果: {result}")
    
    logger.success("\n评估指标测试通过✓")

# ============================================================================
# T5 基线配置文件
# 对应论文Section 3.1的baseline设置
# ============================================================================

experiment_name: "T5_Baseline"
description: "T5 baseline configuration following the paper"

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 模型配置
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
model:
  size: "base"  # 选项: small, base, large, 3b, 11b
  architecture: "encoder_decoder"  # encoder_decoder, language_model, prefix_lm
  
  # Base模型详细配置（220M参数）
  d_model: 768
  d_ff: 3072
  num_heads: 12
  d_kv: 64
  num_encoder_layers: 12
  num_decoder_layers: 12
  
  # 正则化
  dropout_rate: 0.1
  layer_norm_epsilon: 1.0e-6
  
  # 词表
  vocab_size: 32000
  max_seq_length: 512
  
  # 相对位置编码
  use_relative_attention: true
  relative_attention_num_buckets: 32
  relative_attention_max_distance: 128
  
  # 权重共享
  share_encoder_decoder_embeddings: true

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 预训练配置
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
pretraining:
  # 训练步数（论文baseline: 2^19 = 524,288）
  num_train_steps: 524288
  
  # 批次配置
  batch_size: 128  # 序列数量
  max_seq_length: 512
  # 总tokens per batch ≈ 128 * 512 = 65,536 (2^16)
  
  # 优化器（论文使用AdaFactor）
  optimizer:
    type: "adafactor"
    learning_rate: 0.01
    scale_parameter: true
    relative_step: false
    warmup_init: false
  
  # 学习率调度（Inverse Square Root）
  scheduler:
    type: "inverse_sqrt"
    warmup_steps: 10000  # k = 10^4
  
  # 预训练目标（论文最终使用Span Corruption）
  objective:
    type: "span_corruption"
    corruption_rate: 0.15  # 15%的tokens被损坏
    mean_span_length: 3.0  # 平均span长度为3
  
  # 梯度相关
  max_grad_norm: 1.0
  gradient_accumulation_steps: 1
  
  # 混合精度
  fp16: false
  bf16: true  # 推荐现代硬件使用
  
  # 检查点和日志
  save_steps: 5000
  logging_steps: 100
  eval_steps: 5000

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 微调配置
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
finetuning:
  # 训练步数（论文: 2^18 = 262,144）
  num_train_steps: 262144
  
  # 批次配置
  batch_size: 128  # 大多数任务
  batch_size_low_resource: 8  # CoLA, CB等低资源任务
  
  # 学习率（常量学习率）
  learning_rate: 0.001  # 0.001 constant
  scheduler:
    type: "constant"
  
  # 优化器
  optimizer:
    type: "adafactor"
  
  # Early stopping
  patience: 10
  metric_for_best_model: "eval_loss"
  greater_is_better: false
  
  # 检查点（更频繁保存用于early stopping）
  save_steps: 1000
  logging_steps: 50
  eval_steps: 1000
  
  # 微调策略
  finetune_all_parameters: true
  use_adapter: false
  use_gradual_unfreezing: false

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 数据配置
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
data:
  # 预训练数据集
  pretrain_dataset: "c4"  # C4 (Colossal Clean Crawled Corpus)
  pretrain_data_dir: "data/c4"
  
  # 下游任务数据集
  downstream_data_dir: "data/downstream"
  
  # Tokenizer
  tokenizer_model: "models/sentencepiece/t5_32k.model"
  
  # 数据处理
  num_workers: 4
  prefetch_factor: 2
  pin_memory: true

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 输出配置
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
output:
  base_dir: "outputs"
  checkpoint_dir: "${output.base_dir}/checkpoints"
  log_dir: "${output.base_dir}/logs"
  tensorboard_dir: "${output.base_dir}/tensorboard"
  results_dir: "${output.base_dir}/results"
  figures_dir: "${output.base_dir}/figures"

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 硬件和分布式配置
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
hardware:
  # 设备
  device: "cuda"  # cuda, cpu
  
  # 分布式训练
  distributed: false
  world_size: 1
  local_rank: -1
  
  # DeepSpeed配置（可选）
  use_deepspeed: false
  deepspeed_config: "configs/deepspeed_config.json"

# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
# 随机种子
# ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
seed: 42

---
# ============================================================================
# Ablation Study配置示例
# ============================================================================

# 架构对比实验
architecture_ablation:
  base_config: "configs/baseline.yaml"
  
  experiments:
    - name: "Encoder-Decoder"
      architecture: "encoder_decoder"
      num_encoder_layers: 12
      num_decoder_layers: 12
    
    - name: "Encoder-Decoder Shared"
      architecture: "encoder_decoder"
      share_parameters: true
    
    - name: "Language Model"
      architecture: "language_model"

---
# ============================================================================
# 多任务学习配置
# ============================================================================

multitask_config:
  base_config: "configs/baseline.yaml"
  
  # 训练步数（预训练+微调）
  num_train_steps: 786432  # 2^19 + 2^18
  
  # 混合策略
  mixing_strategy: "examples_proportional"  # equal, examples_proportional, temperature_scaled
  
  # Examples-proportional参数
  dataset_size_limit: 524288  # K = 2^19
  
  # Temperature-scaled参数
  temperature: 2.0  # T = 2
  
  # 任务列表
  tasks:
    - "cola"
    - "sst2"
    - "mrpc"
    - "stsb"
    - "qqp"
    - "mnli"
    - "qnli"
    - "rte"
    - "squad"
    - "cnndm"
  
  # 是否包含无监督任务
  include_unsupervised: true
  unsupervised_task: "c4_span_corruption"

---
# ============================================================================
# 评估配置
# ============================================================================

evaluation:
  # 评估任务
  tasks:
    - name: "glue"
      subtasks: ["cola", "sst2", "mrpc", "stsb", "qqp", "mnli", "qnli", "rte"]
      metrics: ["accuracy", "f1", "matthews_correlation", "pearson", "spearman"]
    
    - name: "superglue"
      subtasks: ["boolq", "cb", "copa", "multirc", "record", "rte", "wic", "wsc"]
      metrics: ["accuracy", "f1", "exact_match"]
    
    - name: "squad"
      metrics: ["exact_match", "f1"]
    
    - name: "cnndm"
      metrics: ["rouge1", "rouge2", "rougeL"]
    
    - name: "wmt"
      subtasks: ["en-de", "en-fr", "en-ro"]
      metrics: ["bleu", "sacrebleu"]
  
  # 生成配置（用于SQuAD、摘要、翻译等）
  generation:
    max_length: 128
    num_beams: 4
    length_penalty: 0.6
    early_stopping: true
  
  # 批次大小
  batch_size: 32

---
# ============================================================================
# DeepSpeed配置示例（用于大模型训练）
# ============================================================================

deepspeed_config:
  train_batch_size: 128
  train_micro_batch_size_per_gpu: 4
  gradient_accumulation_steps: 8
  
  optimizer:
    type: "AdamW"
    params:
      lr: 0.001
      betas: [0.9, 0.999]
      eps: 1.0e-8
      weight_decay: 0.0
  
  scheduler:
    type: "WarmupDecayLR"
    params:
      warmup_min_lr: 0
      warmup_max_lr: 0.001
      warmup_num_steps: 10000
  
  fp16:
    enabled: false
  
  bf16:
    enabled: true
  
  zero_optimization:
    stage: 2
    offload_optimizer:
      device: "cpu"
      pin_memory: true
    offload_param:
      device: "cpu"
      pin_memory: true
  
  gradient_clipping: 1.0
  
  steps_per_print: 100
  wall_clock_breakdown: false

---
# ============================================================================
# 日志配置
# ============================================================================

logging:
  # Loguru配置
  level: "INFO"
  format: "<green>{time:YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm:ss}</green> | <level>{level: <8}</level> | <cyan>{name}</cyan>:<cyan>{function}</cyan>:<cyan>{line}</cyan> - <level>{message}</level>"
  
  # 文件日志
  file:
    rotation: "500 MB"
    retention: "10 days"
    compression: "zip"
  
  # TensorBoard
  tensorboard:
    log_every_n_steps: 100
    log_histograms: true
    log_gradients: false
  
  # Weights & Biases（可选）
  wandb:
    enabled: false
    project: "t5-experiments"
    entity: "your-username"
    tags: ["t5", "baseline"]
